ui.title: Modules Wiki
ui.subtitle: A short user-facing guide to what each module does, when it helps, and what you need to enter to get started.

telegram.title: Telegram
telegram.purpose: Operational collection and analytics for Telegram channels.

params.label: Channel or chat
params.name: chatUsername
params.description: Channel link, username, or short chat name.
params.why: Tells the module where to collect data from.

params.label: Key topic
params.name: keyword
params.description: Word or phrase to look for in messages.
params.why: Helps reduce noise and keep the results focused.

params.label: Time period
params.name: dateFrom/dateTo
params.description: Time window for search or analytics.
params.why: Keeps the dataset limited to the relevant period.

streams.name: Analytics
items: Charts, top posts, and active voices

streams.name: Data collection
items: Collection by date range or key topic

youtube.title: YouTube
youtube.purpose: Search, analytics, and comment collection for YouTube videos and channels.

params.label: What to search for
params.name: q
params.description: Topic, phrase, or title used to find videos, channels, or playlists.
params.why: This is the main starting point for the search.

params.label: Channel
params.name: channelId
params.why: Useful when search or analytics should stay within one channel.

params.label: Video
params.name: videoId
params.description: Video ID or full video URL.
params.why: Needed for focused video analytics and comment collection.

params.label: Time period
params.name: publishedAfter/publishedBefore or periodDays
params.description: Publication period or analytics window for the data you want to review.
params.why: Keeps the result set focused on the right time range.

streams.name: Search
items: Search results: title, description, channel, publication date, and preview
Video metrics: views, likes, comments, and engagement level
Filters: region, language, safe search, duration, quality, and captions
Paged loading for large result sets

streams.name: Analytics
items: Aggregated metrics: views, likes, comments, averages, and median values

streams.name: Data collection
items: Comments and replies for the selected video
Sorting by relevance or date and comment search

bluesky.title: Bluesky
bluesky.purpose: Search across Bluesky posts and profiles with analytics for authors and topics.

params.label: What to search for
params.name: q/text
params.description: Topic, phrase, or keywords used to search across posts.
params.why: This is the main starting point for discovery.

params.label: Author or profile
params.name: author/actor
params.description: Profile handle, account name, or profile URL.
params.why: Useful when reviewing one specific source.

params.label: Language or topic filter
params.name: lang/tag
params.description: Extra filters that help narrow the result set.
params.why: Makes it easier to reduce noise quickly.

outputs: Analytics summary for the selected target

streams.name: Search
items: Posts by topic, tag, domain, and mentions

streams.name: Analytics
items: Key metrics for the selected target

mastodon.title: Mastodon
mastodon.purpose: Search across Mastodon accounts, posts, and hashtags with contextual review and analytics.

params.label: What to search for
params.name: q
params.description: Topic, account, hashtag, or text query used for search.
params.why: This defines the starting point for the result set.

params.label: Account
params.name: account
params.description: Account handle in a format such as @name@instance.
params.why: Needed for focused analysis of one author.

params.label: Instance
params.name: instance
params.why: Helps narrow the search to the most relevant source.

outputs: Accounts, posts, and hashtags from search

streams.name: Search
items: Context loading for posts and linked discussions
Access to account posts and followers

streams.name: Analytics
items: Cleaner empty states and user-facing hints

site-intel.title: Site Intel
site-intel.purpose: Technical intelligence for website and domain.

params.label: Website or domain
params.name: target/domain
params.description: Website, page URL, or domain to inspect.
params.why: This is the target of the technical analysis.

outputs: DNS, SSL, and website security checks

news-media-intel.title: News & Media Intel
news-media-intel.purpose: Public news and media mention monitoring.

params.label: Monitoring target
params.name: query
params.description: Topic, person, brand, organization, or event.
params.why: Defines what the news monitoring should focus on.

params.label: Mode and input data
params.name: tab/input
params.description: Choose the operation and provide the source data.
params.why: This determines which tool runs and how it behaves.
